## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (lint, tests on all Python versions, build)
- [ ] Copilot code review requested (automatic or `gh pr edit <n> --add-reviewer Copilot`), re-requested after the last push, and every comment addressed (fixed, or answered and resolved). **Required before merge.**
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, `examples/`) when user-facing behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
